title: Towards Reliable Long-Context Reasoning: Detecting Unanswerable Questions via FactGuard
abstract: arXiv:2504.05607v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) in long-context tasks, their reliability in recognizing unanswerable questions remains a critical challenge. In information-seeking scenarios, models often suffer from overconfidence and hallucinations when evidence is missing or misleading. In this paper, we propose FACTGUARD, a systematic multi-task workflow for generating evidence-grounded answerable and unanswerable questions. We introduce FACTGUARD-BENCH, a benchmark comprising 25,220 examples with context lengths up to 128K, specifically targeting Lack of Evidence and Misleading Evidence scenarios. Evaluations of eleven representative open-source and proprietary LLMs reveal a significant reliability gap: models struggle to reject unanswerable questions as context scales, with the leading model achieving only 71.62% accuracy. translated_title: 迈向可靠的长上下文推理：基于FactGuard检测不可回答的问题
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在长上下文任务中取得了成功，但它们在识别不可回答问题方面的可靠性仍然是一个关键挑战。在信息检索场景中，当证据缺失或具有误导性时，模型往往会出现过度自信和幻觉问题。在本文中，我们提出了FACTGUARD，这是一个系统化的多任务工作流，用于生成基于证据的可回答和不可回答问题。我们推出了FACTGUARD-BENCH，这是一个包含25,220个样本的基准数据集，上下文长度最高达128K，专门针对证据缺失和误导性证据场景。对十一个具有代表性的开源和专有大型语言模型的评估揭示了显著的可靠性差距：随着上下文规模的扩大，模型难以拒绝不可回答的问题，表现最好的模型准确率仅为71.62%。通过使用FACTGUARD-BENCH进行训练，我们将整体准确率提升至81.17%，并显著增强了模型在长上下文场景下的可靠性。
tldr: 本文提出FactGuard多任务工作流及包含25,220个样本、上下文长度达128K的FactGuard-Bench基准，用于检测长上下文场景中证据缺失或误导的不可回答问题，并通过该基准训练将最优模型的准确率从71.62%提升至81.17%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FactGuard, a multi-task workflow, and FactGuard-Bench, a benchmark of 25,220 examples with contexts up to 128K, to detect unanswerable questions under missing or misleading evidence, improving the leading model's accuracy from 71.62% to 81.17%.
